items.title: A ruinous review: Sac State falls short to Toledo
items.summary: Sacramento State football matched up in its first ever Wednesday night game as a part of the Mid-American Conference against Toledo. The Hornets fought until the very end, but fell short to the Rockets by a score of 20-17.

items.title: FOOTBALL EDGED BY TOLEDO, 20-17, IN HOME FINALE
items.summary: The Sacramento State football team played arguably its best half of the season in the first half but could not hold off Toledo in the second half as the Rockets prevailed, 20-17, on Wednesday night at Hornet Stadium.

items.title: Sac State Says: Football post-game show sentiments are skewed
items.summary: Students reacted to the Sacramento State football post-game concerts, after Diplo performed homecoming weekend, and Ty Dolla $ign Don Diablo is set to perform on Nov. 4. This comes just days after the one year anniversary of Lil Yachty’s post game concert that ended prematurely due to safety concerns.

items.title: Native American Heritage Day showcases new uniforms and collaborative efforts
items.summary: Sacramento State will honor Native American Heritage month with the debut of it’s new uniforms for the football game against Toledo on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026 at 4 p.m. The uniforms were made in collaboration with Wilton Rancheria.

items.title: FIVE FACTS FOR FOOTBALL VS. TOLEDO
items.summary: All you need to know prior to Wednesday afternoon's MACtion battle between the Hornets and Toledo.

items.title: Ready for takeoff: Sac State looks to ride momentum in it’s game against Toledo
items.summary: Sacramento State hosts their final home game of the season as they take on the Toledo Rockets on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026 at 4 p.m. The Hornets look to start a win streak after picking up a 31-10 win against Kent State.

items.title: Plays of the Week: dominant defense, first MAC win and game-sealing kills
items.summary: Rounding out the top five plays from Sacramento State sports is senior Donovan Turner with his fourth quarter pick-six.

items.title: ENE, PULOKA CLAIM MAC PLAYERS OF THE WEEK AWARDS
items.summary: A season of firsts continued for Sacramento State football as Isaiah Ene and Fata Puloka became the first players in school history to earn Mid-American Conference Players of the Week awards. items.title: Monday Morning Quarterback: Sac State finally has a signature win
items.summary: Sacramento State’s win over Kent State was more than its first FBS and MAC victory. It gave the Hornets a defensive identity, leaned into Isaiah Ene as a cornerstone and provided head coach Alonzo Carter’s staff with the kind of tape that can sell recruits on the program’s future.

items.title: FOOTBALL PLAYS FINAL HOME GAME ON WEDNESDAY AGAINST TOLEDO
items.summary: For the first time in school history, Sacramento State will get a taste of MACtion as the Hornets welcome Toledo on Wednesday, Nov. 4, at 4 p.m. PT. The game will be the last one at Hornet Stadium this season.

items.title: FOOTBALL CLAIMS FIRST MAC WIN WITH 31-10 VICTORY OVER KENT STATE
items.summary: Isaiah Ene rushed for a career-high 107 yards and the Sacramento State defense recorded five takeaways to lift the team to a 31-10 victory over Kent State on Friday night at Hornet Stadium.

items.title: FIVE FACTS FOR FOOTBALL VS. KENT STATE ON FRIDAY NIGHT
items.summary: All you need to know prior to tonight's game against Kent State.

items.title: FOOTBALL TAKES ON KENT STATE ON FRIDAY NIGHT
items.summary: Friday night lights return to Hornet Stadium on Oct. 30 when Sacramento State will face Kent State for the first time. The game will kickoff in front of a national television audience at 7:30 p.m. PT.

items.title: FOOTBALL SEES BALL STATE PULL AWAY IN SECOND HALF IN 34-17 LOSS
items.summary: Jackson Sharman threw two touchdown passes and Boogsie Silvera had a pair of interceptions but Sacramento State could not contain Ball State quarterback Keldric Luster in a 34-17 loss on Saturday afternoon at Scheumann Stadium.

items.title: VISIT THE HORNET EXCHANGE!
items.summary: Sacramento State Athletics has launched the Hornet Exchange — a program designed to help student-athletes benefit from their name, image and likeness — it was announced today.
